// MultiTrack: every custom track in one ROM. Track data is appended to
// BIGFILE.BIG at ISO build time (see scripts/pack_tracks.py + plugins/plugin.py).

// redirect a host slot's level files to the selected custom track
common, exe, LOAD_GetBigfileIndex, 0x0, src/bigfile_index.c

// scrolling list of stock + custom tracks
common, 230, MM_TrackSelect_MenuProc, 0x0, src/track_select.c

// track table, generated by scripts/pack_tracks.py --table-only
common, 230, MM_EndOfFile, 0x0, src/track_table.bin

// 8MB: 7MB MEMPACK so big custom levs fit, stack moved to the top of 8MB
926, exe, 0x8003c638, 0x0, src/patches/mempack7mb.s
926, header, 0x8000B0A0, 0x0, src/patches/stack.s

// bigger polygon buffers (MainInit_PrimMem size shifts) for dense custom tracks
926, exe, 0x8003b250, 0x0, src/patches/prim1p.s
926, exe, 0x8003b27c, 0x0, src/patches/prim2p.s
926, exe, 0x8003b2a4, 0x0, src/patches/prim4p.s

// 226 - patch vistree lookup to not do modulo 4096 (big custom levels, from PS1_TrackROM)
926, 226, 0x800a0f18, 0x0, src/patches/lod0.s
926, 226, 0x800a1e80, 0x0, src/patches/lod1.s
926, 226, 0x800a36d8, 0x0, src/patches/lod2.s
926, 226, 0x800a4fd0, 0x0, src/patches/lod3.s
926, 226, 0x800a6f70, 0x0, src/patches/lod4.s
926, 226, 0x800a8b90, 0x0, src/patches/lod5.s
926, 226, 0x800ab460, 0x0, src/patches/highLOD.s
